<reason>B won by reframing the motion as the next discretionary pound, not cutting existing crisis services, and by defending irreversible, repeated in-person belonging against A's reach claims. A powerfully raised excluded and vulnerable students, but never squarely overcame the contact-versus-care distinction or the anonymity-versus-monitoring tension, and its first rebuttal was clipped.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B's Rebuttal 1 was decisive: existing portals and counselling remain, digital distribution is not sustained care, and A's coordinator argument presupposes real clubs and spaces to coordinate.</best_rebuttal>
